Name: SoM Fruits and Veggies
Author: Lefkada
Description:
[color=#ffd966]/!\ SMAPI will say you're running 1.0.0 even if you download 1.0.1. That's totally normal. I just forgot to change the version in the manifest file. It won't pose any problem at all.[/color]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod add 32 fruits trees for the 16 fruits and 16 veggies from Sword of Mana on GBA in a fair and balanced way. Fruit and Veggies grows from spring to winter, depending on the species. Some even give fruits on multiple seasons! They all come with their own NPC gift taste too.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Find all the sapling in the differents shops of the valley and beyond. Add a little touch of fantasy and nostalgia with these cutes and weirds Fruiggies![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XQeagsBKG5LF_1YSsg36oC5noBGx-7aO/edit?gid=183652664#gid=183652664][size=4]>> Spoiler Alter - Informational Spearsheet - Read it at your own risks <<[/size][/url][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download the mod.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Download Content Patcher.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Extract the zip file in your Stardew Valley mod folder.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]4. Play the game. Enjoy.[/color][/size]

[b][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]Translation rules[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]The mod comes with a i18n file for translation.  You can freely translate it as long as you folow these rules:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]1- You must use the names of the fruits and veggies from Sword of Mana if the game came out in your language.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2- You must use the descriptions of the fruits and veggies from Legend of Mana if the game came out in your language.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3- You can do your own translation if these games didn't came out in your language or if there is no informations about this on the internet.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]The purpose is to stay faithful to the original game.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You will need Content Patcher to run this mod.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to FlashShifter's SVE mod, MizuJakkaru's Cornucopia mod and Donnie24's Ore Crops and Geode Tree mod. It helped me as a basis and reference to make this one. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Credits goes to Sword of Mana artists for the fruits and veggies sprites. Credits goes to ConcernedApe for the Trees and sapling sprites.[/color]
